title: We need to go over "Uncanny Valley" Calling a discussion to ALL AI-Game Devs
author: Novel-Common9013
selftext:
There are 68K of weekly visitors from past week (It was about approx 55K).

People in here need rid of to "AI Slop" is a propaganda term by US & UK gov.

I noticed that discussions around "AI slop" seem to have become much more common recently (I've seen traffic on related discussions grow a lot over the past week). It makes me wonder whether public perception is changing, or whether the term is simply being applied more broadly.

  
So, I'm asking;

* Do you think the uncanny valley can be used as a deliberate artistic choice?
* Have you ever played a game where slightly "off" characters actually improved the atmosphere?
* As an indie developer with limited resources, would you lean into stylization, embrace the uncanny, or avoid realistic humans altogether?

  
What can do better for realizing this graph on the top?
